value.rationale: Disjoint-cycle product tori are structurally motivated canonical degree-three classes in graph braid topology. Q4 is a natural symmetric nonplanar test graph. Checking all 1112 tori, not just square faces, exhibits a genuine rank-one rational failure of product-torus generation, with an explicit small-integral-coefficient witness. This precise finite obstruction is nontrivial, is absent from the closest examined classifications, and clarifies structural limits of natural torus constructions. A downstream general theorem is not claimed or needed.
